name: Pig and Whistle Tavern
summary: In Stormwind City's Old Town, the Pig and Whistle Tavern welcomes travelers and local laborers. Veterans gather there to remember the kingdom's past conflicts.

sections.title: A Refuge in Old Town
sections.body: In Old Town's winding alleys, the Pig and Whistle Tavern offers warmth, ale, and lodging. Common citizens, working folk, and travelers fresh from the road gather there. Merchants such as recipe vendor Kendor Kabonka share the room with grizzled veterans, who trade memories of the First and Second Wars over their tankards.

faq.q: Where is the Pig and Whistle Tavern located?
faq.answer: The Pig and Whistle Tavern stands in Old Town, Stormwind City's eastern district, among military barracks, rogue dens, and working-class quarters.

aliases: who is in pig and whistle
faq.answer: Travelers, guards off duty, and veteran soldiers who swap stories of the First and Second Wars frequent the tavern. Merchant Kendor Kabonka, who sells cooking recipes, is there as well.

faq.q: What services does the tavern provide?
aliases: is pig and whistle an inn
faq.answer: The Pig and Whistle Tavern offers weary travelers a place to rest and buy food, drink, and specialized cooking recipes.

angles.text: Cooks come to the tavern to find Kendor Kabonka, who sells a collection of rare cooking recipes from across Azeroth.
For Alliance soldiers and travelers passing through the capital, the tavern offers a welcoming hearth and company with veterans of the realm's earlier wars.
